params.name: model
params.description: The name of the Builder.io content model to query.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Maximum value is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

params.name: query
params.description: MongoDB-style JSON query filter applied to content fields. Example: {"data.slug":{"$eq":"my-page"}}

params.name: userAttributes
params.description: JSON object of user attributes used for targeting and personalization. Example: {"urlPath":"/about","country":"US"}

params.name: url
params.description: The current page URL used for targeting by urlPath. Used as a shorthand for setting userAttributes.urlPath.

params.name: locale
params.description: The locale code for localized content retrieval (e.g., "en-US").

params.name: enrich
params.description: When true, enriches references and Symbol blocks with their full content data instead of returning only IDs.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Reduces payload size by returning only specified fields.

params.name: includeRefs
params.description: When true, includes referenced content objects inline.

params.name: cacheSeconds
params.description: Override the CDN cache duration in seconds.

items.docs: Retrieves published content entries for a given model name. Supports MongoDB-style query filters, user attribute targeting, locale, pagination, and field selection. Results are sorted by priority by default.

info.name: Get a single content entry by ID

params.name: model
params.description: The name of the Builder.io content model.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the content entry.

params.name: enrich
params.description: When true, enriches referenced content inline.

items.docs: Retrieves a single content entry from a Builder.io model by its unique ID.
